protocol: V3.4 20-epoch three-seed cross-fitted shared-weight dual-view DeiT3 (manuscript arm A2)

backbone.pretrained: supervised ImageNet-22k pre-training, ImageNet-1k fine-tuning (Apache-2.0 weights)
backbone.trainable_parameters_note: 85.82 M is the manuscript value with the 4-class head; the upstream timm checkpoint has 86,585,320 parameters in total including its 1000-class head.

crop_candidates.note: Purely geometric crops; never a lung mask or a lesion segmentation. round() is used for pixel sizes and integer floor division for centring.

selector.features: frozen 768-D DeiT3 global + six crops, shape 558 x 7 x 768 (development)
selector.classifier: L2 logistic regression, C = 0.03, class_weight = balanced, max_iter = 1700
selector.rule: pick the crop whose expert gives the highest maximum class probability
selector.train_assignment: inner 3-fold StratifiedGroupKFold out-of-fold choice inside each outer training part (inner seed 1137 + fold)
selector.eval_assignment: six experts refitted on the whole outer training part

training.loss: class-weighted cross-entropy on both views, weights 0.80 global / 0.20 regional
training.augmentation: Resize 224 bicubic + RandomAffine(degrees=7, translate=0.03, scale=0.97-1.03, fill=0)

inference.seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean of the three seed models

evaluation.primary: four-class top-1 accuracy on 288 held-out same-source images
